metadata.title: Man on Ladder with Text Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in dark clothing and sunglasses, partially ascending a wooden ladder against a two-toned wall. The man is positioned in the lower left and center, looking upwards and to the left. A script-style text overlay is present in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's body forms a diagonal line, mirroring the ladder's angle.
The two-toned wall creates a horizontal division, contrasting with the vertical elements of the man and ladder.
The text overlay is positioned to balance the visual weight of the man and ladder.
The dark attire of the man contrasts with the lighter wall sections, drawing attention to him.
coreInvariants: The man is always partially obscured by the ladder or positioned to suggest movement.
The two-toned wall with a distinct horizontal line is a constant background element.
The script typography always appears in the upper right quadrant.
The overall color palette remains warm and earthy, dominated by browns and creams.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man occupies the lower-left to mid-center of the frame, scaled to be prominent but not overwhelming, allowing space for the background and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and upper body, directed upwards and left, serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the man's face, following his gaze upwards and left, then potentially to the text in the upper right, and finally down the ladder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space exists in the upper left and upper right quadrants, providing breathing room and highlighting the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Brown (wall, ladder, man's clothing) provides a warm, earthy, and grounding dominant tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/light beige (upper wall) offers a soft contrast to the dominant brown, creating visual separation and brightness.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The subtle sheen on the man's jacket and the white of his fingernail provide very minor, almost imperceptible, accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The image features a low to medium saturation, with a range of values from dark browns in the clothing and lower wall to lighter creams in the upper wall. The overall feel is muted and sophisticated.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, earthy, and neutral color scheme.
Limit high-contrast color pairings to maintain a soft aesthetic.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The text 'The Chocolate Edition' uses a flowing, connected script style with varying stroke widths. 'The' is smaller and positioned above 'Chocolate Edition'.
letterConstructionRules: All letters are connected in a cursive style.
Capital letters are significantly larger and more ornate than lowercase letters.
Stroke widths vary, with thicker downstrokes and thinner upstrokes.
Letters feature decorative flourishes and loops, particularly on 'C', 'h', 'E', and 'd'.
The baseline of 'Chocolate Edition' has a slight upward curve.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in 'The' is a highly stylized capital with a long, elegant crossbar.
The 'C' in 'Chocolate' is a large, ornate capital with a prominent loop.
The 'E' in 'Edition' is also a large, ornate capital with a distinct loop.
The 'h' in 'Chocolate' has an extended ascender that loops back.
The 'd' in 'Edition' has a decorative loop on its ascender.

typesetting.alignment: left-aligned within its block, but the block itself is right-aligned to the image edge
typesetting.lineBreakPattern: two lines: 'The' on top, 'Chocolate Edition' below

composition.scale: prominent, but not overshadowing the main subject
composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space, complementing the overall composition

treatment.shadow: subtle drop shadow, slightly offset to the bottom right, in a darker shade of brown/black
treatment.texture: subtle, slightly rough or brushed texture within the fill

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: No explicit pairing, as it's a single custom lettering piece. If additional text were needed, a sans-serif or serif with good legibility would contrast well.

avoid: Sans-serif or serif fonts for the main title
Bright or contrasting colors for the text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Formal Script fonts (e.g., Bickham Script Pro, Edwardian Script ITC)
candidateDirections.reason: These fonts offer the flowing, connected, and ornate characteristics, though custom modifications would be needed for specific flourishes and the 'The' placement.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Calligraphic Script fonts (e.g., Aphrodite Slim Pro, Burgues Script)
candidateDirections.reason: These provide the elegant stroke variation and decorative elements, but might require significant modification to match the exact letterforms and connections.
This would allow for precise replication of the unique flourishes, connections, and textured appearance, ensuring an exact match.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate the image of the man on the ladder against the two-toned brown and cream wall, ensuring appropriate lighting and shadows. Leave the upper right quadrant clear of any distracting elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the custom-lettered text 'The Chocolate Edition' in the upper right quadrant. Apply a dark brown/black fill with a subtle texture and a soft, dark drop shadow offset to the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the text clearly legible against the background?
Does the text maintain its custom-lettered, flowing script appearance?
Are the shadow and texture treatments applied correctly?
Is the text positioned without overlapping the man or the ladder?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of brown and cream for the wall
Lighting intensity and direction on the man and background
Specific texture applied to the text fill
Offset and blur of the text drop shadow
Scale of the text relative to the overall image

mustAchieve: A warm, slightly desaturated color palette.
A clear visual hierarchy with the man as the primary subject and text as a secondary, integrated element.
The custom script lettering must convey elegance and a slightly vintage feel.
The overall mood should be sophisticated and understated.
avoid: Cluttered composition that distracts from the subject or text.

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's pose and expression convey the intended mood.
Verify that the ladder and wall textures appear realistic and consistent.
Confirm the text's legibility and aesthetic integration with the background.
Check for any unintended visual artifacts or distortions.
Assess the overall balance and harmony of the composition.
Ensure the shadow on the text is subtle and adds depth without being distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the scene with a similar subject, pose, and background color scheme. Replace the custom lettering with new text, maintaining the script style, two-line composition, and textured/shadowed treatment. Adjust the scale and position of the new text to fit the new subject and composition.
